MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 6

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 17

7. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 11
   D. 4

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x < 5

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

13. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 15
   D. 1

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

16. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

17. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

18. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

19. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 41

20. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 64

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

22. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 17
   C. 1
   D. 73

23. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

24. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 3
   D. 17

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
